name: Elektron Analog Four
description: Elektron Analog Four four-voice analog synthesizer (MKI): every parameter of its manual's MIDI appendix, as the controllers and NRPNs it prints, on the synth, FX, CV and performance channels.

sources.title: Analog Four User Manual, OS 1.56
sources.notes: MIDI appendix read by tools/profiles/elektron/read-elektron-midi.mjs from Analog-Four-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.56_260930.pdf (sha256 f2d48fb7f3a558eea2e7a9c472536e9c5ad5e8a72a96c1d1badce4ce0ef25798), https://www.elektron.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Analog-Four-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.56_260930.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/elektron/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/elektron/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI appendix, with its printed name, sent on the CC it prints (a 14-bit pair where it prints an LSB), or its NRPN where it prints no CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The appendix prints no ranges: each parameter takes what its controller carries, 0 - 127 (0 - 16383 for a pair). What a value shows, and the values of a setting chosen from a list, are in the parameter's chapter of the manual.
The channel variable is a track's channel (track 1's by default): the parameters go to that track. Set it to the AUTO channel to edit whichever track is active.
Left out, the wheels, pedals and breath controller, which set nothing of the sound: MODULATION Modwheel, MODULATION Breath Controller.
The fxChannel variable is 16 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's FX track channel (GLOBAL SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The cvChannel variable is 14 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's CV track channel (GLOBAL SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The perfChannel variable is 15 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's PERF CHANNEL (GLOBAL SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
An NRPN-only parameter is sent as its number (MSB on CC 99, LSB on CC 98) and a 7-bit value on data entry (CC 6), which the appendix does not spell out; not checked against the instrument.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers (or NRPNs, as its PARAM OUTPUT setting says) when its knobs are turned
